archetypes.name: wire-format-regression
archetypes.rationale: This fix depends on the exact compose-report and parse-input wire boundary.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether Tier A compose-report issue-input now places the public dedup marker where issue parse-input preserves it. Check both terminal-failure and escalation-success paths by inspecting shared composition code and the regression test. Flag any change that affects Tier B, signature hashing, redaction, or parse_issue_input behavior. Cite files and line numbers for every finding. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
